license: CC BY 4.0; official dataset page, absent per-sequence exception
selection: Nearest RGB timestamp to each fixed fraction of the full rgb.txt timestamp span; tie resolves earlier timestamp. No GT or prediction score influences selection.
input_regime: Six unchanged RGB PNGs per sequence; no depth/GT in proposer input manifest. Calibration-aware vs unknown intrinsics must be registered separately before model execution.
ground_truth_policy: groundtruth.txt and depth metadata/files reserved for evaluator. RGB optical camera-to-world mocap poses; explicit timestamp association within 0.02 seconds, no invented interpolation. Depth uint16/5000 metres, zero invalid; no second depth scale correction.
separation: Separate inputs and evaluator directory trees; not OS-enforced sealing. No reconstruction or ground-truth-driven fitting in this preparation.
failure_policy: Every fixed sequence retained including timeout, mismatch, missing matches; no automatic retries, substitutions or budget reset. Partial archives retained on remote.
independence: Three sequence/setup strata, not three proven independent rooms; common lab environment and model pretraining exposure unknown. Separate from previous AHa three-source cohort.
claim_boundary: External sensor trajectory/depth references enable future diagnostics but acquisition itself is not accuracy, benchmark success or SOTA.
